about.title: Local intelligence for international decisions.
about.intro: BTIS — Bangba Tinbo Intelligence et Stratégies — places local intelligence at the service of investors, institutions and partners preparing a decision in Burkina Faso.
about.mission: Give investors and partners a strategic reading of the market, its actors and its opportunities, so that decisions are better informed.
about.vision: Help bring structuring investments to life in Burkina Faso and in Africa, by building bridges between capital, expertise and local opportunities.

principles.title: Rigour
principles.text: Keep the analysis within what can actually be established.

principles.title: Intelligence
principles.text: Read the actors, the market and the context before concluding.

principles.title: Confidentiality
principles.text: Protect mandates that cannot be made public.

principles.title: Impact
principles.text: Connect economic potential with a contribution to development.

steps.title: Analyse
steps.text: Read the market, the actors and the context.

steps.title: Qualify
steps.text: Distinguish what deserves to be pursued.

steps.title: Structure
steps.text: Organise the opportunity and the conditions for carrying it out.

expertises.title: Capabilities designed to inform decisions and support action.

invest.title: Burkina Faso as a landscape of opportunity.
invest.subtitle: BTIS supports investors seeking to understand, identify and develop strategic opportunities in education.
invest.whyText: BTIS uses these as lines of inquiry. They describe fields of work, not measured findings.

opportunities.title: Higher education
opportunities.text: Universities, specialised schools and professional training.

opportunities.title: Infrastructure
opportunities.text: Campuses, training centres and specialised infrastructure.

invest.marketText: BTIS reads an opportunity through its context, its actors and the conditions required to carry it out. That reading comes before any decision. It is not a quantified study: such a study is produced only within a mandate.
invest.roleText: We do more than identify an opportunity. We work to understand its context, its stakeholders and the conditions required to carry it out.

operations.title: A credibility library, held by confidentiality.
operations.intro: Publishable operations will appear here, with their context, BTIS’s role and their result. No reference is added until it can be made public.
operations.confidential: Some mandates and operations cannot be described in public, for reasons of confidentiality.

insights.title: Notes to inform a decision.
insights.intro: These texts set out how BTIS reads a situation. They are not market studies and they do not advance figures.
insights.sourcesEmpty: No external source is cited. This note is not a substitute for documented research.

contact.title: Write to us to qualify your request.
contact.intro: This form is for sending a message. Describe your organisation, your role and the purpose of your request. For a video or phone conversation, use the meeting page.
contact.messagePlaceholder: Briefly describe your project or your need.
contact.meetingTitle: Would you rather schedule a meeting?
contact.meetingText: Format, preferred period and purpose of the conversation: a dedicated page, separate from this form.
contact.directText: For a first written exchange, you can also write or call directly.
contact.success: Your message has been sent. BTIS will reply to the address you provided.
contact.errorUnconfigured: Request delivery is not configured on this server.
contact.errorSend: Delivery failed. Please try again in a moment.
contact.errorInvalid: Some fields need to be corrected.
contact.errorShort: Briefly describe your project or your need.

meeting.title: Schedule a conversation with BTIS.
meeting.intro: No calendar is displayed. Indicate the format and preferred period: BTIS will propose a time by email.
meeting.note: This is not a general message. It is only used to organise a conversation.

steps.title: You set the frame
steps.text: Format, period and purpose of the conversation, so the meeting is useful from the first minute.

steps.title: BTIS proposes a time
steps.text: You receive a proposal by email, adapted to your time zone and the nature of the request.

steps.title: The conversation takes place
steps.text: Video, phone or in person in Ouagadougou, according to the format selected.

meeting.objectivePlaceholder: What would you like to discuss in this meeting?
meeting.directText: No instant slot. BTIS confirms the meeting after reading your request.
meeting.writeText: If you only want to write, without organising a conversation, use the Contact page.
meeting.success: Your meeting request has been sent. BTIS will propose a time by email.

meeting.errorInvalid: Some fields need to be corrected.
meeting.errorShort: Please specify the objective of the conversation.

partners.title: Selected collaborations, held by confidentiality.
partners.intro: BTIS works with institutions, operators and local actors when the strategic fit is real. No partner is named here until the relationship can be made public.
partners.whyText: A partnership is not a showcase. It serves to inform a decision, structure an operation or connect stakeholders around a project in Burkina Faso, particularly in education.
partners.kindsIntro: These categories describe types of actors. They are not a list of references.

kinds.title: Institutions
kinds.text: Public, diplomatic or development actors preparing a decision or an intervention.

kinds.title: Education operators
kinds.text: Schools, training organisations and education project holders.

kinds.title: Investors
kinds.text: Investors and co-investors seeking local grounding and a reading of the market.

kinds.title: Local actors
kinds.text: Burkinabè stakeholders needed to understand the context and to execute.

partners.confidential: Names, logos and mandates are published only when they can be. The absence of a list is not an absence of work.

points.title: A clear purpose
points.text: Intelligence, advisory, introductions or operational support — not a partnership for display.

points.title: A local reading
points.text: BTIS brings the context, the actors and the conditions required to operate in Burkina Faso.

points.title: Assumed confidentiality
points.text: Some collaborations remain off the site, by the nature of the mandate.

partners.applyTitle: Would you like to become a partner?
partners.applyText: Describe your organisation and the purpose of the collaboration. BTIS will reply after reading the request.
partners.applyPageIntro: This form is used to qualify a collaboration. It does not create a partnership automatically.

applySteps.title: You set the frame
applySteps.text: Organisation, type of actor and purpose of the partnership, to assess the fit.

applySteps.title: BTIS assesses the fit
applySteps.text: The request is read against our expertise, the Burkinabè context and the confidentiality of mandates.

applySteps.title: A framework is discussed
applySteps.text: If interest is mutual, BTIS proposes how a collaboration could work.

partners.formNote: Every request is handled confidentially. No logo is published without agreement.
partners.proposalPlaceholder: What kind of collaboration would you like to explore with BTIS?
partners.asideText: BTIS does not publish an open call. Each partnership is examined on the basis of your proposal.
partners.investorText: If you are looking to invest rather than structure an operational partnership, use the investor path.

joinInvestor.title: Qualify an investment interest with BTIS.
joinInvestor.intro: This path is not a subscription. It is used to understand your profile, your interest and the support you expect, before any introduction.
joinInvestor.forText: Investors, family offices, funds, institutions and companies that want to read Burkina Faso — particularly education — before deciding.
joinInvestor.marketCta: Read Investing in Burkina Faso first

steps.title: You specify your profile
steps.text: Type of investor and sector interest, with no public ticket size and no commitment.

steps.title: BTIS shares a reading
steps.text: Context, actors and conditions required — not a brochure with figures.

steps.title: The next step is structured
steps.text: If the fit is confirmed, BTIS supports qualification, then possible execution.

joinInvestor.formNote: No minimum ticket is published. Qualification comes before any discussion of an operation.
joinInvestor.proposalPlaceholder: What kind of investment or support would you like to explore?
joinInvestor.asideTitle: What BTIS does not do here
joinInvestor.asideText: No online fundraising, no return promises, no list of confidential operations.
joinInvestor.partnerText: If you represent an operator, an institution or a local actor, the partner path is a better fit.
